instruction: Execute a terminal command to count all lines in Go source files (.go) recursively in the current directory and show the total on the terminal

parameters.command:
cat > /home/user/project/views/home.go << 'EOF' // File: views/home.go package views func RenderHome() string { return ` Home Page

Welcome to our application!

` } EOF

Created 4 Go files: main.go (12 lines), models/user.go (16 lines), controllers/user_controller.go (14 lines), views/home.go (15 lines). Verified with Python script: Total = 57 lines. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric from general.py to verify terminal output contains '57'.
